source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.5.1 (PDF 146, printed 143).

blocks.text: Data visualization complex maloomat samajhne ka taqatwar tareeqa hai. Har qism ka visualization alag kaam aata hai aur data ko samajhna aur us ka jaiza lena aasan banata hai. Neeche kuch aam qismein tafseel se di gayi hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi data visualization ki qism NAHI hai: Bar Chart, Scatter Plot, Hypothesis Test ya Heatmap? (MCQ 3) Do qismein bata kar likhiye ke har ek kab istemal karenge. (Short question 3)
blocks.explanation: (c) Hypothesis Test; yeh statistics ka tareeqa hai, chart nahi. Bar chart categories ka muwazna karta hai, jaise mukhtalif products ki sales; line graph waqt ke saath rujhan dikhata hai, jaise din bhar ka temperature.

items: Qismein: bar chart, line graph, histogram, scatterplot, boxplot; hypothesis test chart nahi.
